inputs.text: Vijayan can call the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations politically motivated, but that does not answer the public’s questions about the proposed Cooperative Department software project. Cooperative institutions are built on trust and careful stewardship of people’s money; dismissing scrutiny as partisan politics only deepens suspicion. Those entrusted with public funds should provide clear answers and let the facts speak.
